dialogues.en: I made a big yawn, and got up from bed.
dialogues.text: I made a big yawn, and got up from bed.

dialogues.en:
Nemu's starting her duty as a student in charge of
discipline. I should watch her condition closely as she'll
be doing extra work.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's starting her duty as a student in charge of
discipline. I should watch her condition closely as she'll
be doing extra work.

dialogues.jp: 大きな｛あくび／欠伸｝をかまし、ベッドから起き上がる。

今日から音夢は風紀委員の仕事だ。その分、普
段よりも体力を使うから、体調をみててやらな
いと。
dialogues.en:
I got dressed and went down to the front door to put my
shoes on. The sun was shining brightly when I opened the
door.
dialogues.text:
I got dressed and went down to the front door to put my
shoes on. The sun was shining brightly when I opened the
door.

dialogues.en:
I kept walking ahead with the cherry blossom petals falling
everywhere.
dialogues.text:
I kept walking ahead with the cherry blossom petals falling
everywhere.

dialogues.jp:
着替えをすませ玄関で靴を履く。ドアを開ける
と、太陽のまぶしい光が目に飛び込んでくる。

窒息しそうなほど舞い落ちる桜の花びらを顔に
受けながら、桜並木を突き進む。
dialogues.en:
I could hear the usual sound by this time. 'Mellow
xylophone'.
dialogues.text:
I could hear the usual sound by this time. 'Mellow
xylophone'.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の隣を歩く眞子が振り返る。
dialogues.en: Mako turned around next to Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: Mako turned around next to Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、萌先輩に朝の挨拶を期待するのは無理
か……。
dialogues.en:
I shouldn't have expected to get a morning greeting from
Moe-sempai......
dialogues.text:
I shouldn't have expected to get a morning greeting from
Moe-sempai......

dialogues.jp:
音夢の様子を見なきゃならんので、早々にふた
りと別れ、校門に向かう。
dialogues.en: I left them behind as I had to check up on Nemu at the gate.
dialogues.text: I left them behind as I had to check up on Nemu at the gate.

dialogues.jp: 顔にあたる桜の花びらが、マジ鬱陶しい。
dialogues.en:
The cherry blossom petals hitting my face were very
annoying.
dialogues.text:
The cherry blossom petals hitting my face were very
annoying.

dialogues.jp:
登校途中、この時間帯の名物、『気の抜けた木
琴』遣いとその妹に遭遇した。音夢の様子が気
になるので、俺はとっとと先を急いだ。
